description: Use when designing, reviewing, or troubleshooting Salesforce object relationships and field type choices — lookup vs master-detail, junction object modeling, indexing strategy, and data model anti-patterns. NOT for drawing or diagramming the model — use architect/salesforce-erd-and-diagramming. NOT for the Setup steps to create the object itself — use admin/object-creation-and-design. NOT for hierarchical or external relationship types, polymorphic lookups, or the per-object relationship limits — use admin/lookup-and-relationship-design.
inputs: List of objects involved and their approximate record volumes
Whether rollup summaries or cascade delete are needed
Anticipated query patterns (fields used in WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY)
Integration requirements (upsert via external ID, API access)
name: data-model-design-patterns
official_sources: Object Reference (`object_reference.txt`), "Relationships Among Objects": master-detail cascade delete, owner from master, sharing inherited, required on the detail page layout, reparenting off by default, standard objects can't be the detail of a custom object, the eight objects that can't be the master, junction objects with two master-detail fields, lookups not automatically required (L3254-3302).

Metadata API Developer Guide (`api_meta.txt`), CustomField: `deleteConstraint` values Cascade, Restrict, SetNull (default) (L43348-43356); `relationshipOrder` primary/secondary for junctions (L43582-43591); `reparentableMasterDetail` default false (L43593-43596); `summaryForeignKey` is the master-detail field (L43648-43649); `writeRequiresMasterRead` (L43725-43732); `externalId` types, `unique`, `caseSensitive` (L43328, L43402-43404, L43702).

Apex Developer Guide (`salesforce_apex_developer_guide.txt`): cascade deletes succeed only if each child can be deleted (L8236-8240); Recycle Bin for 15 days and undelete (L8259-8262); default indexes and when a custom index isn't used (L9641-9663).
Apex Reference Guide (`salesforce_apex_reference_guide.txt`): `emptyRecycleBin` takes the top-level Id for cascade-deleted records (L206927-206931).

Best Practices for Deployments with Large Data Volumes (`salesforce_large_data_volumes_bp.txt`): custom index thresholds (L463-471); unindexable types and deterministic formulas (L409, L483-484); skinny tables (L329-385).

Salesforce Developer Limits and Allocations Quick Reference (`salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.txt`): a custom object allows up to 40 relationships (264 L687-691); a query operation has 2 minutes to execute (264 L665-669). Values unchanged from the 262 edition (L1131-1134, L1101-1104).
REST API Developer Guide (`api_rest.txt`): upsert key matched multiple times returns a 300 error (L2977); `explain` plans (L17784-17867).
Salesforce Help — Enable 'cascade delete on custom lookup relationships' feature — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000382017&language=en_US&type=1
outputs: Relationship type recommendation (lookup vs master-detail vs junction object) with rationale
Field type selection guidance for data integrity
Indexing strategy recommendation (standard, custom index, skinny table)
Data model anti-pattern findings with remediation steps
